d:
Bihar ke mokama se purv vidhayak aur bahubli neta anant sinh (chhote sarkar) apne patna sthit aavas par ek bar phir apne khas aur bebak desi andaj ko lekar surkhiyon men hain.
Jahanabad se daurkar aae phain ka samman:
Jahanabad ke hulasganj se sirph anant sinh se milne ke lie daurkar patna pahunche ek phain ka svagat karte hue anant sinh ne kaha ki "ham bhi apne prashanskon se utna hi prem karte hain."
